messages:
elaine: Hey team - FinScale POC report: they say free trial credits ran out ~2 hours earlier than our dashboard shows. Customer says they hit a hard stop during demo :grimacing:. Can someone triage? (request id attached)
ryan: @elaine can you paste the request_id and the model they were using?
elaine: request_id=rc_20260315_88f3, model=redwood-small-1, mode=streaming, max_tokens=1024, streaming_chunk_size=64
jordan: saw a similar report before — streaming sometimes double-counts when prefix caching is enabled. will pull logs now :eyes:
mike: quick check: any 429s or quota_exceeded in infra logs around that time?
elaine: customer saw `429: quota_exceeded` in client UI. They forwarded this snippet:

```
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z ERROR request=rc_20260315_88f3 status=429 reason=quota_exceeded billed_tokens=0
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z INFO request=rc_20260315_88f3 user=fin_scale mode=streaming tokens_in=120 tokens_out=900 cache_hit=true
```

ryan: interesting - billed_tokens=0 but client saw quota stop. Could be mismatch between metering service and quota enforcement. I will check metering logs for request_id.
billing-bot: Notification: free_credits for account fin_scale shifted to 0 at 2026-03-15T14:01:58Z (source=usage_pipeline)
sam: copying billing logs now. preliminary: usage pipeline uses 'billed_tokens' column aggregated by minute. If streaming partial chunks counted twice we could see spike.
mike: can you check if our streaming aggregator emits both partial-chunk and final-chunk token counts? I remember a patch last month.
ryan: found related lines in metering_agg:

```
2026-03-15T14:01:58Z AGG request=rc_20260315_88f3 chunk_index=0 chunk_tokens=120 cumulative=120
2026-03-15T14:02:00Z AGG request=rc_20260315_88f3 chunk_index=1 chunk_tokens=64 cumulative=184
2026-03-15T14:02:05Z AGG request=rc_20260315_88f3 finalize cumulative=900 billed=900
```

ryan: so metering shows billed=900 which matches final output. but billing-bot shows free credits exhausted before finalize at 14:01:58. that indicates upstream pipeline sent a pre-aggregate spike.
jordan: maybe prefix cache emitted a synthetic event early that consumed credits in the real-time counter. check realtime_meterer topic.
sam: pulling realtime events... found an event at 14:01:59: `realtime_charge request=rc_20260315_88f3 provisional=950` — looks like provisional estimator overshot due to prefetched tokens.
elaine: so customer saw quota at 14:02:12, billing shows credits zero at 14:01:58, realtime provisional charge at 14:01:59 overshot — that's consistent.
ryan: root cause hypothesis: provisional estimator double-counts cached prefix tokens during streaming for small chunk sizes, causing provisional counter to hit credit limit and enforce quota before finalize.
mike: low-risk mitigation: temporarily bump FinScale's free_credits by +2k while we patch estimator. Sam can we do that? We should also mark it as P0 for customer demo schedule.
sam: I can add a one-off free_credit grant and create an invoice hold. Doing now — patch ETA 10m.
billing-bot: Action logged: grant_free_credits account=fin_scale amount=2000 issued_by=sam at 2026-03-15T14:04:10Z
elaine: customer confirmed demo resumed after grant :relieved:. Thanks team.
ryan: I'll open an infra bug: STREAM-527 — provisional estimator double-counts cached tokens for streaming. Will include reproducer and logs.
ryan: quick repro steps in case helpful:

1) enable prefix cache
2) open streaming session with chunk_size <= 64
3) send prompt that triggers long final output
4) watch realtime_meterer provisional > final

mike: I'll queue a canary fix to avoid counting cached_prefix tokens in provisional estimator. target hotfix within 48hrs, rollback safe.
jordan: also adding a customer-facing note in POC doc explaining how free credits and provisional counters work for streaming (to avoid confusion).
elaine: next steps: sam did one-off credit grant, ry an opens STREAM-527, mike schedules hotfix, jordan updates POC notes. I'll follow up with customer and confirm they received internal postmortem.
ryan: assigned STREAM-527 to eng-runtime team. ETA for patch PR 2 days, hotfix 48hrs if no regressions.
sam: billing reconciler will run a backfill to ensure final billed tokens replace provisional charges for the invoice — I'll follow up in billing ticket.
elaine: great. closing for now. thanks all :tada:
